scope: single canonical route and single main-render contract
root_cause: Outer control-center routing wrote control_center while the inner Autonomi workspace wrote autonomy plus aa_tab.
The competing routes could trigger repeated reruns and restore different pages during manual refresh.
A one-shot Autonomi tab request could be consumed before the radio state was stabilized.
The generic aa_tab value could contaminate tab state for unrelated workspaces.
repairs: One canonical navigation route is selected per visible panel.
Autonomi workspace state is established before the workspace radio renders.
Route tabs are restored only to the workspace that owns them.
Persistent UI state stores the active route tab instead of a stale tab from another panel.
Paper Trading uses paper_trading as its canonical route.
The early direct report-render path was removed so one selector and one renderer own the visible workspace.
live_render_pending: Only one main workspace is visible after repeated manual refresh.
Autonomi / Rapporter remains selected after at least five refreshes.
No duplicate Autonomi or Rapporter tree appears below the active page.
Back/forward navigation restores the same group, panel and inner tab.
Valutavarsler remains active after each action.
Paper Trading and all other control-center panels preserve their own tabs.
Normal navigation does not enter a rerun loop or become progressively slower.
